## Scope
Design-only Windows RTX 5070 Ti Laptop successor. Stacked on frozen #209 head `2d076402b4ddc29c92549d360cd974af40d3f0a4` for reconstruction context; changes are two new documents only. No GPU execution, baseline edits, optimization, manuscript edits or merge.

## Scientific value
- Distinguish true physical q8 from historical caller8/UB4 (#62).
- Retain #195 evidence that Qwen packing can regress; test all eight cut × projection × k arms rather than LP only.
- Independent immutable Windows scalar R and full-vector/KV/lifecycle qualification precede clean timing.
- Equal work: identical state/eight tokens/eight owned full outputs; two q4 calls versus one q8 at verified geometry.
- Main prospective panel: 16 roots × 8 arms × 8 fully position/ordered-neighbor-balanced Williams blocks = 1024 measurements +128 primers; cap96 and prompt≤192 are fixed before outputs.
- Four preregistered width contrasts with paired-root intervals; separate mechanism family, complete costs, negative cells and limits. No new M-superiority or architecture-causal claim.

## Bounded execution
May start on authorized RTX without waiting for A5000 #210. New ceiling2048 requests; reconcile historical RTX904/3072 and557528/4M row ledger first. The main panel conservative row bound is2,211,840 if the audited inherited formula applies; all other jobs require explicit counts and admission. No shrinking correctness gates to fit quota. No32B/B570 expansion.

## Files and checks
`benchmarks/rtx_q8_transfer_20261109/PLAN.md` and Chinese executor prompt in `README.md`. Verified8×8 position balance and all56 directed neighbor pairs exactly once, request/row arithmetic and full remote file readback at `ad9fb6846dd979c3a76d3c415c74fa9f86565f7d`. No native tests or memory-fit claim. No automatic execution merely from PR creation.
